datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Madagascar to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Classification data were spatially referenced and compiled into geographic datasets for multiple scenarios and projection periods throughout 2021, representing population-level food security impact assessments.
